In a forgotten corner of the galaxy, two civilizations collide in a brutal dance of survival and exploitation:

The Primal Tribe

A race of hyper-fertile humanoids (optional: anthro/furry/monster traits) who worship fertility itself. Their bodies evolved to repopulate rapidly - females go into heat monthly, males produce excessive semen, and pregnancies last mere weeks. They rut openly, celebrate orgies during harvest moons, and view reproduction as sacred... until they came.

The Ascendancy

An advanced alien empire facing extinction due to sterility plague. Their scientists discovered this primitive tribe's DNA holds the key to salvation - but extracting it requires... hands-on research. Now their sleek black harvest ships descend upon tribal lands, armed with neural disruptors, aphrodisiac drones, and adjustable breeding racks.
